gloss: to cook through; to heat thoroughly

definitions.gloss: to cook through; to heat (food) thoroughly
definitions.explanation: To cook or heat food so that it is done all the way through, often to make raw food safe to eat. The transitive partner of the expression meaning 'to be cooked through'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す。
⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{火|ひ}を{通|とお}して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧。
examples.english: Cook the vegetables briefly, then chill them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{火|ひ}を{通|とお}して⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, to prevent food poisoning, I make a point of cooking even fish before eating it.

notes:
Conjugates like ⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (godan, transitive). The food takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す: to cook thoroughly
- さっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す: to cook briefly, to heat lightly
- {火|ひ}を{通|とお}した⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: cooked vegetables

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive partner of ⟦{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る→火が通る：34054_higatooru⟧ (to be cooked through). Recipes use {火|ひ}を{通|とお}す for what the cook does and ⟦{火|ひ}が{通|とお}る→火が通る：34054_higatooru⟧ for the state of the food.
